metadata.task: If the trash bin is full, replace the trash bag; otherwise dispose of the waste.

plan.goal: Replace the trash bag in the Trash Bin if it is full; otherwise, dispose of the waste into the Trash Bin.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Verify the state of the Trash Bin (full or not) and locate the Trash Bag.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at Kitchen Entrance. Trash Bin state is unknown. Trash Bag location is unknown.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is at Trash Bin. Trash Bin state is known (Full or Not Full). Trash Bag location is known.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot must move to the Trash Bin location to interact with it.
Robot needs to perceive the Trash Bin to determine its state (full/not full).
Robot needs to find the Trash Bag to proceed with replacement if necessary.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Execute the conditional logic: Replace bag if full, else dispose of waste.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at Trash Bin. Trash Bin state is known (Full or Not Full). Trash Bag location is known.
checkpoints.exit_state: Trash Bag replaced (if full) OR Waste disposed (if not full).

grounded_skills.reason: Verify if the Trash Bin is full based on visual perception.
Robot picks up the Trash Bag from its location.
Robot places the new Trash Bag into the Trash Bin.
Robot picks up the Waste item.
Robot disposes of the Waste into the Trash Bin.

constraints: Robot is fixed-base and cannot navigate autonomously. Navigation commands must be simulated or executed via teleoperation/localization updates.
Robot lacks visual perception and object detection capabilities. This plan assumes hypothetical execution or requires external vision system integration not present in the provided capabilities.

execution_summary.failure_reason: The robot H2 lacks critical capabilities required for this task: 'can_navigate', 'can_detect_objects', 'has_visual_perception', 'can_pick', 'can_place', and 'can_transport'. The robot is fixed-base, tethered, and has no sensors (cameras, lidar) to perceive the environment, locate the Trash Bin, detect its fullness, or manipulate objects like the Trash Bag or Waste.
execution_summary.expected_outcome: Task cannot be completed due to missing robot capabilities.
